lines.text: Joining a team sounds risky. Will everyone now see all my tasks, my notes, and my private docs?
The answer is no. Nothing is shared just because you joined, and everyone keeps their own account.
Your account, your agents and your workspaces all stay yours. A team only links them if you ask it to.
To share anything, first pick a workspace. Sharing is decided per workspace, never for the whole account.
Then choose what to share. Tasks, memory, and skills each have their own switch.
Shared tasks are read only. Teammates can follow progress, but they cannot change what you asked for.
For the Pano, share one doc at a time. The launch plan can go to the team while your private notes stay home.
And changed your mind? Unshare it, and the team stops seeing it right away.
If you leave the team, every share stops with you. Nothing stays behind in anyone else’s view.
Agents obey the same switches. A teammate agent can only read what you chose to share, and nothing more.
What would you want to keep private from your team? Tell us in the comments, and try Teams at Agent R Q dot com.
